verdict.rationale: Financial Connections documents a flow for collecting and instantly verifying a linked bank account so it can be used for ACH Direct Debit payments. A charge can therefore be pulled from a connected account. However, the evidence shows account linking that feeds an ACH debit flow, not a payment-initiation (pay-by-bank) product, and the docs state no live geographies; only community comments say it is US-only. missing for 10: a documented payment-initiation API that pushes payments from the connected account, first-party statement of supported geographies, hands-on corroboration of the payment flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can initiate a bank payment from a connected account — a documented pay-by-bank or payment-initiation product with its live geographies stated honestly

citations.quote: Collect a bank account for ACH Direct Debit payments while using account data, including balances.
instant | Financial Connections only, with no manual entry and microdeposit fallback
We use the link to bank accounts for instant account verification and as a fraud signal for ACH payments.
